_comment: Right-click context help. Transcribed from EVANHELP::_plntsum_screen_help_list (evanhelp.cpp:118, 15 entries, s_help_box {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2} orion2.h:993), installed by EVANHELP::Set_PlntSum_Screen_Help_List_ (evanhelp.cpp:298) from PLNTSUM::Planet_Summary_Screen_ (plntsum.cpp). `native` is the original's 640x480 rectangle and is provenance only - HD resolves each region from its own boxes, because the HD layout puts the controls somewhere else. Regions are tested in order and the first hit wins, like fields::Check_Help_List_ (fields.cpp:2916). THE LIST HAS NO SCREEN-WIDE ENTRY: the original's last entry, 338, is the header strip over the list, so a right click outside every region opens nothing - on this screen, as in the original, that is a Cancel and not a help box.
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
